description.value:
Frequency once per encounter

Trigger You reduce a creature of your level or higher to 0 Hit Points.

Something in you settles the moment the job stops being outstanding.

You regain Hit Points equal to twice your level, end one condition of your choice affecting you, and gain 1 Tally. This does not trigger off a creature that was already helpless, unconscious, or unable to fight back — the job has to have been a job.

cinderfall.incomplete: On reducing a foe to 0 HP: heal 2x level, end one condition of the caster's choice, gain 1 Tally. No "Heal" rule-element key exists anywhere in pf2e-source/src/module/rules/rule-element/ (only the inverse, lose-hit-points.ts) -- self-healing as a resolved reaction effect has no hook at all. Condition removal has no rule-element path either, and the Tally gain is the same unbuilt homebrew resource as clean-twice.
